title: GTA 6: The Official Facts
approvedClaims: Grand Theft Auto VI is coming to Vice City and the wider state of Leonida.
Grand Theft Auto VI is scheduled for November 19, 2026.
Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos are central characters.
An easy score goes wrong and a criminal conspiracy stretches across Leonida.
The announced launch platforms are PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X and S.
